# readmine

[![CI](https://github.com/rishbCLN/readmine/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/rishbCLN/readmine/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/readmine.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/readmine)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org)

**Generate a beautiful README for your project in seconds — an interactive, zero-dependency wizard that reads your package.json and writes the docs for you.**

## Install

Run it once with no install:

```bash
npx readmine
```

Or install it globally:

```bash
npm install -g readmine
readmine --help
```

## Usage

```bash
readmine --help
```

## Scripts

| Script | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run test` | `node --test` |
| `npm run start` | `node bin/readmine.mjs` |
